subject.title: fix(sessions): prune stale entries independently of maxEntries gate

question: Should `loadSessionStore(..., { runMaintenance: true })` become a supported independent below-cap TTL deletion path despite having no production caller?
rationale: The proposed change does not repair the established gateway path; accepting it would define broader persisted-session behavior in a second maintenance implementation.

options.title: Keep canonical maintenance ownership
options.body: Remove the load-only semantic change and address supported configuration diagnostics, documentation, and real write-path behavior.

options.title: Create an explicit load contract
options.body: Approve and document full load-time retention, add a production owner or caller, align artifact cleanup, and prove upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical maintenance ownership
recommendation.body: Remove the load-only semantic change and address supported configuration diagnostics, documentation, and real write-path behavior.
